params.prompt: Create a single seamless tileable architectural material texture, square 1024x1024: refined honed warm ivory limestone with very subtle natural mineral variation and fine pores, desaturated cream and pale neutral grey, no strong veins. This is a flat albedo texture for a precise interactive building maquette, not a photograph of a room. Uniform diffuse unlit color, orthographic straight-on view, no cast shadows, no bevels, no tiles or grout lines, no perspective, no text, no objects, no baked lighting. Match left/right and top/bottom edges seamlessly. Keep low contrast so teal navigation paths remain clearly readable over it. Professional restrained museum architectural model material.
